name: omnia-platform
description: Plataforma SaaS modular do ecossistema Omnia Frigo Holding
author: Omnia Frigo Holding

scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:public-companies && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:holding-companies-seed && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:seed-holding-home && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:seed-holding-institutional-pages && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:seed-holding-blog && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:seed-holding-strategic-companies && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:upgrade-holding-home && pnpm --filter @omnia/shared test:public-page-contracts && pnpm --filter @omnia/shared test:public-post-contracts && pnpm --filter @omnia/shared test:public-company-contracts && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:public-page && pnpm --filter @omnia/admin test:public-posts && pnpm --filter @omnia/web test:seo && pnpm --filter @omnia/web test:seo-blog && pnpm --filter @omnia/web test:seo-companies
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
scripts.docker:staging:migrate: docker compose -f docker/compose/staging.yml --env-file .env.staging --profile bootstrap run --rm admin-migrate
scripts.docker:staging:seed: docker compose -f docker/compose/staging.yml --env-file .env.staging --profile bootstrap run --rm admin-seed
scripts.docker:staging:bootstrap: docker compose -f docker/compose/staging.yml --env-file .env.staging --profile bootstrap run --rm admin-bootstrap
scripts.docker:production:migrate: docker compose -f docker/compose/production.yml --env-file .env.production --profile bootstrap run --rm admin-migrate
scripts.docker:production:logs: docker compose -f docker/compose/production.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f admin web
